title: "Suggest a Topic"

Have an idea for a future note? Share the topic and a brief description
of what you would like me to cover.

```{=html}
<form
  id="topic-suggestion-form"
  class="topic-suggestion-form"
  action="https://formsubmit.co/hasnainfrnz@gmail.com"
  method="POST"
>
  <input
    type="hidden"
    name="_subject"
    value="New topic suggestion — Danish297"
  >

  <div class="topic-field">
    <label for="topic-name">Topic name</label>
    <input
      id="topic-name"
      name="topic"
      type="text"
      placeholder="e.g. Oracle 23ai vector search"
      maxlength="120"
      required
    >
  </div>

  <div class="topic-field">
    <label for="topic-description">Short description</label>
    <textarea
      id="topic-description"
      name="description"
      rows="4"
      placeholder="What would you like to learn about this topic?"
      maxlength="1000"
      aria-describedby="description-help"
      required
    ></textarea>

    <small id="description-help">
      A few sentences are enough. Maximum 1,000 characters.
    </small>
  </div>

  <p class="topic-privacy">
    Suggestions are sent through FormSubmit. Please do not include
    personal or confidential information.
  </p>

  <button class="button" type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>

<script>
(() => {
  const form = document.getElementById("topic-suggestion-form");
  if (!form) return;

  const button = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
  let submitting = false;

  form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (submitting || !form.reportValidity()) return;

    submitting = true;

    const originalLabel = button.textContent;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
      controller.abort();
    }, 30000);

    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = "Sending…";
    form.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");

    let success = false;
    let errorMessage = "";

    try {
      const endpoint = new URL(form.action);

      if (
        endpoint.protocol !== "https:" ||
        endpoint.hostname !== "formsubmit.co"
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "The form submission address is not configured correctly."
        );
      }

      endpoint.pathname =
        "/ajax/" + endpoint.pathname.replace(/^\/(?:ajax\/)?/, "");

      const response = await fetch(endpoint.href, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Accept": "application/json"
        },
        body: new FormData(form),
        signal: controller.signal
      });

      if (response.status >= 500) {
        throw new Error(
          "The submission service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later."
        );
      }

      const responseText = await response.text();
      let result;

      try {
        result = JSON.parse(responseText);
      } catch {
        throw new Error(
          "The submission service returned an unexpected response. Please try again later."
        );
      }

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        String(result.success).toLowerCase() !== "true"
      ) {
        const serviceMessage = result.message || result.error;

        throw new Error(
          typeof serviceMessage === "string"
            ? serviceMessage
            : "The submission service did not confirm your suggestion."
        );
      }

      success = true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Topic submission failed:", error);

      if (error.name === "AbortError") {
        errorMessage =
          "The submission request timed out. Delivery could not be confirmed. Retrying may create a duplicate.";
      } else if (
        error instanceof TypeError ||
        error.message === "Failed to fetch"
      ) {
        errorMessage =
          "The submission service could not be reached, or its response could not be read. Please try again later.";
      } else {
        errorMessage =
          error.message || "An unexpected error occurred.";
      }
    } finally {
      window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      submitting = false;
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = originalLabel;
      form.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
    }

    if (success) {
      form.reset();

      window.alert(
        "Thank you for the suggestion. I will review it and take the necessary action."
      );
    } else {
      window.alert(
        "Your suggestion could not be confirmed.\n\n" +
        errorMessage +
        "\n\nYour text has been kept in the form."
      );
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

Suggestions help me plan future notes, but publication is not guaranteed.
